indicator.name: Gasto sanitario corriente
indicator.description: Gasto sanitario corriente como porcentaje del PIB.
indicator.null_policy: No se interpola ni se convierte en cero.
indicator.methodology: Mide recursos corrientes destinados a salud, no resultados sanitarios, calidad ni eficiencia.

official_metadata.name: Current health expenditure (% of GDP)
official_metadata.source_note: Level of current health expenditure expressed as a percentage of GDP.  Estimates of current health expenditures include healthcare goods and services consumed during each year. This indicator does not include capital health expenditures such as buildings, machinery, IT and stocks of vaccines for emergency or outbreaks.
official_metadata.source_organization: Global Health Expenditure Database, updated December 12th, 2025, World Health Organization (WHO), uri: https://apps.who.int/nha/database

transformations: clasificación explícita de países y agregados
